verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the Beichen Delta of Kaifu District, where the Xiang River and Liuyang River converge.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Changsha sits prominently in the Beichen Delta of Kaifu District, where the Xiang River and Liuyang River converge.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is four metro stops from Wuyi Square, the city's commercial heart.
verified_facts.excerpt: is just four metro stops from Wuyi Square, the city's vibrant commercial heart.

verified_facts.text: The Three Halls and One Center cultural complex and the Beichen Hui commercial hub are within walking distance.
verified_facts.excerpt: with the Three Halls and One Center cultural complex and Beichen Hui commercial hub within easy walking distance.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a cruiser-style facade and a 27-metre-high atrium, combining international design with the cultural heritage of Hunan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Combining the essence of the world's designers and the cultural heritage of Hunan, hotel cruiser façade and 27m high atrium

verified_facts.text: Rooms are contemporary in design and styled with local cultural flair.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms are contemporarily designed, elegantly furnished and styled with local cultural flair.

verified_facts.text: Each room has a marble bathtub and a separate walk-in rainforest shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: luxurious marble bathtub and separate walk-in rainforest shower

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms offer views of the Xiangjiang River.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Changsha offers full-equiped luxury guest rooms with fantastic river views of Changsha’s Xiangjiang River.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has a heated indoor swimming pool with a sky view.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Fitness Center features a fully-equipped gym, heated indoor swimming pool with sky-view.

verified_facts.text: The indoor pool includes a whirlpool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pool includes: Whirlpool

verified_facts.text: The hotel's spa is Abel Touch SPA, with a sauna and steam bathing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Abel Touch SPA

verified_facts.text: Abel Touch SPA treatments include foot reflexology.
verified_facts.excerpt: Foot Reflexology

verified_facts.text: Zhi Wei Xuan Chinese Restaurant serves Cantonese and Hunan fusion cuisine with sweeping views of the Xiangjiang River.
verified_facts.excerpt: A premier fine dining destination, offering sweeping views of the Xiangjiang River and masterfully crafted Cantonese and Hunan fusion cuisine

verified_facts.text: SKY27, the rooftop bar on the 27th floor, has a panoramic view of the Xiangjiang River and the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a panoramic view of the Xiangjiang River and city skyline, guests often liken it to being in Manhattan, London, or Shanghai.

verified_facts.text: Xiang Show Hunan Restaurant serves authentic Hunan cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Xiāng Show is your gateway to authentic Hunan cuisine, crafted with tradition, elevated with finesse.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers loaner bikes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Loaner bikes

verified_facts.text: The hotel is close to Changsha Binjiang Cultural Park, Changsha Museum and Joy City.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is close to Changsha Binjiang Cultural Park, Changsha Museum & Joy City.

verified_facts.text: Orange Isle Scenic Spot lies in the middle of the Xiang Jiang River, facing Yuelu Mountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Orange Isle Scenic Spot is located in the middle of the Xiang Jiang River.

verified_facts.text: Changsha Huanghua International Airport is about 32 kilometers from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at InterContinental Changsha.
